display_name: Phase1 source-trained differentiable physical posterior mixture
description: Source-trained neural controller corrects six posterior weights and returns their continuously mixed IQ waveform to frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; no DURA inference.
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU0, source-only training, CPU 2 threads, TF32 disabled

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256], six blind physical posterior IQ hypotheses and frozen F features; source-trained continuous mixture
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: Only L_s fit labels enter training; U_s uses high-confidence frozen clean F pseudo labels, no U_s truth, V or test
data.validation_ref: 384 fixed RX8 source heldout IDs, 64 per impaired view; previously explored, no true-label evaluation
data.leo_config_ref: Fresh source cache epoch21/22/23 training; source cache epoch19 evaluation

permissions.query_use: Only source fit L_s truth and U_s high-confidence clean F pseudo targets; no U_s truth/V/test
permissions.claim_scope: Source source IDs used by F and seen in other channel views, pseudo targets not independent test; bounded correction may exploit classifier

checkpoint.initialization: Zero-output initialized controller, frozen six-component blind source physical posterior and frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; DURA loaded after training for source comparison only.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Blind action SHA256 0ef60a205f785bda45f9936d519e925179dbbddeef2fd6cd285a83b02a284338 and source prior SHA256 5e35516d54d3e3d1d1749933861f290c1f87c8ffdb4b863d2f9819914135ceb9
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: 4096 fixed fit IDs disjoint from 8192 prior IDs; views 21/22/23; 8 epochs, final weight; fixed correction scales 0.5, 1, 2 on 384 RX8 source diagnostic records. No target selection or automatic test.

execution.gpu_policy: GPU0 single owner, TF32 disabled, source-only training, real source gradient preflight

metric_names: eligible source train exposures and L_s labels
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Legal L_s source fit labels and U_s clean F pseudo labels; softmax(log prior weights + learned correction), frozen F cross entropy + 0.2 IQ MSE + 0.02 KL; no identities or target IQ at inference.

rows.method: learned continuous six-hypothesis IQ mixture with physical posterior anchor
rows.purpose: jointly optimize frozen-ground-base recognition and source IQ preservation
rows.seed_notes: 4096 fit IDs disjoint from 8192 prior IDs, fit seed 2026121855, training order seed 2026121856
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes
rows.budget_ref: 4096 source fit IDs x 3 fixed views, 8 epochs, 384 RX8 source probe
